blocks.tamil_translation: Uqbah ibn Amir (RA) reports that the Prophet ﷺ said this to him.

blocks.arabic_text: عَنْ عُقْبَةَ بْنِ عَامِرٍ ﵁ قَالَ: قَالَ رَسُوْلُ اللهِ ﷺ: اََلَمْ تَرَ آيَاتٍ اُنْزِلَتِ اللَّيْلَةَ لَمْ يُرَ مِثْلُهُنَّ قَطُّ؟ (قُلْ اَعُوْذُ بِرَبِّ الْفَلَقِ۞) (قُلْ اَعُوْذُ بِرَبِّ النَّاسِ۞).
blocks.source_reference_arabic: رواه مسلم، باب فضل قراءة المعوذتين، رقم:١٨٩١
blocks.tamil_translation: “Do you know of the ayahs that were revealed to me tonight? Those ayahs are unequalled. Ayahs like these have not been seen before”. They are Surah “Qul a'udhu birabbil falaq” and Surah “Qul a'udhu birabbin-nas”,” Hazrat Uqbah ibn Amir (RA) reports that Rasulullah ﷺ said.

blocks.arabic_text: عَنْ عُقْبَةَ بْنِ عَامِرٍ ﵁ قَالَ: بَيْنَا اَنَا اَسِيْرُ مَعَ رَسُوْلِ اللهِ ﷺ بَيْنَ الْجُحْفَةِ وَاْلاَبْوَاءِ اِذْ غَشِيَتْنَا رِيْحٌ وَظُلْمَةٌ شَدِيْدَةٌ، فَجَعَلَ رَسُوْلُ اللهِ ﷺ يَتَعَوَّذُ بِ»اَعُوْذُ بِرَبِّ الْفَلَقِ» وَ»اَعُوْذُ بِرَبِّ النَّاسِ» وَهُوَ يَقُوْلُ: يَا عُقْبَةُ! تَعَوَّذْ بِهِمَا، فَمَا تَعَوَّذَ مُتَعَوِّذٌ بِمِثْلِهِمَا قَالَ: وَسَمِعْتُهُ يَؤُمُّنَا بِهِمَا فِي الصَّلوةِ.
blocks.source_reference_arabic: رواه ابو داؤد، باب في المعوذتين، رقم:١٤٦٣
blocks.tamil_translation: Hazrat Uqbah ibn Amir (RA) reports, “Once I was travelling with Rasulullah ﷺ between the places called “Juhfah' and “Abwa', when suddenly a violent windstorm and intense darkness surrounded us. Rasulullah ﷺ began seeking protection with Allah by reciting the two surahs “Qul a'udhu birabbil falaq” and “Qul a'udhu birabbin-nas”. And he said, “O Uqbah, you too seek protection by reciting these two surahs, seek refuge; no one has sought protection with anything else like these surahs.
